ios.desc:
Stop drowning in Moodle tabs, scattered deadlines, and last-minute cramming. 
Coursly connects to your university's Moodle account and turns the chaos into one clear plan: courses, deadlines, grades, and AI study sessions, automatically.
Then AI builds your daily study plan so you always know what to do next.

AUTO-IMPORT FROM MOODLE
Connect once and Coursly syncs your courses, assignments, deadlines, and grades straight from your university's Moodle. No more copying due dates by hand.
  
AI COURSE ANALYSIS
Coursly reads your syllabi and course documents to extract what actually counts: exams, assignments, participation, and the weighted grade breakdown for each course.

DAILY AI STUDY PLANS
Get a personalized study plan each day, built around your real deadlines, workload, and course priorities. You always know what to work on next.
   
GRADE TRACKING
Track your grades by course and category with weighted calculations that match your syllabus. Know exactly where you stand before the exam. 

REVISION QUIZZES
Coursly turns your lecture material into quick revision quizzes so you can test yourself and walk into exams ready.

VOICE TASKS
Speak your tasks naturally. Coursly parses what you say into structured, actionable to-dos.

COURSLY PREMIUM
Unlock daily AI study plans, auto revision quizzes, deadline scanning from your slides, more voice tasks, and fast background sync with a Premium subscription. Monthly, semester, and yearly plans available, with a free introductory period.
